note: Ida County Conservation Board park 3 miles south of Battle Creek on the north side of 62-acre Crawford Creek Lake (no-wake). The upper loop is on the hillside with 50-amp sites and a view over the park; the lower loop (30-amp) is nearer the water. Both loops have restrooms with showers; dump station on the upper loop; on-site host. Boat ramp, fishing jetties, camper cabins and trails. --Claude
